query:
INSERT INTO device_kv_bodies (kv_key, owner_id, nonce, ciphertext, aad)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(kv_key, owner_id) DO UPDATE SET
             nonce      = excluded.nonce,
             ciphertext = excluded.ciphertext,
             aad        = excluded.aad,
             created_at = datetime('now')
